newsitem.title: USA: Embassy Acquisition to buy Orthodontix.
newsitem.headline: Embassy Acquisition to buy Orthodontix.

text.p: Embassy Acquisition Corp on Tuesday said it reached a tentative agreement to acquire Orthodontix Inc for about 2.8 million common shares and $2.5 million.
Orthodontix was founded in September 1996 to provide management services to orthodontic practices.
Under the terms of the proposed transaction, each Orthodontix share will be converted into one Embassy share.
The company now has outstanding 2,540,000 common shares and warrants for the purchase of an additional 120,000 shares.
